source: 719 Advancing
target: 719 Progrediens

source: “We were under the influence of an Under the Table transaction?” Franca carefully reviewed the entire situation but couldn’t find anything out of the ordinary.
target: “Eramusne sub imperio transactionis ‘sub mensa’?” Franca totam rem diligenter perquisivit, sed nihil prorsus extra solitum reperit.

source: The only thing that stood out was that the Demoness of Black probably had a way to quickly extract Moran Avigny while he was under the protection of an official Beyonder team.
target: Unum solum quod eminuit erat, quod Demonissa Nigra, verisimiliter, viam habebat celeriter Moran Avigny extrahere, dum sub tutela turmae officialis Beyonder esset.

source: She clearly knew how to exploit the mirror world, yet she burdened everything upon her.
target: Clare scivit quomodo mundum specularum ad usum suum converteret, attamen omnia sibi onere imposuit.

source: Of course, her actions made sense when put into context.
target: Profecto, eius actus sensum habebant, cum in contextu considerabantur.

source: Even though Moran Avigny’s security detail consisted of Mid-Sequence Beyonders, this was Trier, the capital of the Intis Republic.
target: Quamquam custodia Moran Avigny ex Beyonder Medi‐sequentibus constabat, hoc erat Trier, caput Reipublicae Intis.

source: It was a diocese of great importance to both the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the God of Steam and Machinery Church.
target: Illud erat dioecesis maximi momenti tam Ecclesiae Aeternae Solis Ardentis quam Ecclesiae Dei Vaporis et Machinarum.

source: Numerous demigods were posted there, ready to intervene at a moment’s notice.
target: Multi semidei ibi constituti erant, parati ut instante intervenirent.

source: If the Demoness of Black couldn’t end the fight quickly and eliminate all witnesses, she would face severe repercussions.
target: Si Demonissa Nigra pugnam celeriter finire atque omnes testes tollere non valuisset, poenas graves patiretur.

source: Official Beyonders might even track her using specialized Sealed Artifacts.
target: Beyonder officiales eam etiam vestigia explorare poterunt, utens artefactis sigillis distinctis.

source: If something happened to her, the Demoness Sect’s Trier branch would be dealt a crippling blow.
target: Si quid illi evenisset, ramus Trierensis Sectae Demonissarum ictu gravissimo percussus esset.

source: In a situation like this, it would be wiser for her to assign a capable member of middling rank to handle the matter while she focused on damage control.
target: In tali re, melius erat ut membrum idoneum ex ordine mediocris ad rem gerendam delegaret, dum ipsa damnum coercere contendebat.

source: If things went south, she could easily cut ties with Franca and her lovers.
target: Si res male evenissent, facile nexus cum Franca et eius amatoribus dissolvere posset.

source: This assumed, of course, that Moran Avigny wasn’t valuable enough for the Demoness Sect to go to great lengths to eliminate him.
target: Hoc praesupponebat, scilicet, quod Moran Avigny non esset satis pretiosus, ut Sectae Demonissarum ad eum exstirpare longas conatibus adirent.

source: If he were, the sect would have evacuated non‐essential personnel beforehand and assembled high‐ranking, color‐named Demonesses in Trier.
target: Si ille praetiosus esset, secta prius personam non essentialem removeret atque Demonissas summi gradus, nomine colorato, in Trier congregavisset.

source: “I think there’s an issue here. It’s not that we shouldn’t or can’t abandon the mission, but rather that we gave up far too readily and hastily,” Anthony remarked, analyzing the situation from a human behavioral standpoint.
target: «Putō hic rem esse gravem. Non id est quod negotium relinquere non debeāmus aut non possimus, sed potius quod nimis cito et festinanter cederemus,» Anthony inquit, rem ex prospectu morum humanorum examinans.

source: Franca nodded pensively and added, “Indeed.”
target: Franca meditabunda caput inclinavit et addidit: «Vere.»

source: The Demoness of Black only briefly verified the absence of hidden Beyonders behind the mirror in question before concluding that Moran Avigny had been abandoned and would receive no further assistance.
target: Demonissa Nigra modo brevemente absentiam Beyonder occultorum post speculum commemoratum comprobavit, antequam conclusit Moran Avigny desertum esse et nullo ulteriore auxilio futurum.

source: “That’s way too rushed and convenient,” Jenna commented.
target: «Id nimis festinatum et opportunum est,» Jenna dixerat.

source: After a moment’s hesitation, she asked, “Was Madam Judgment affected as well?”
target: Post paulum dubitationis, illa quaesivit: «An etiam Domina Iudicium affecta sit?»

source: “It’s possible.” Lumian glanced down at his chest.
target: «Verisimile est,» Lumian in pectus suum deiecto aspexit.

source: Lowering his voice, he asked, “Termiboros, why weren’t you impacted? Is it because you’re an Angel?”
target: Vocem demittens quaesivit: «Termiboros, cur non affectus es? Num quia angelus es?»

source: Termiboros’s imposing voice echoed within Lumian’s body.
target: Voce imponente Termiboris intra corpus Lumiani resonabat.

source: “It’s hard to say for certain.”
target: Difficile est certo dicere.

source: It could also be due to The Fool’s seal.
target: Fortasse etiam propter sigillum Stulti est.

source: While the seal does limit me, it can also serve as a safeguard under certain circumstances.
target: Quamquam sigillum me limitat, sub quibusdam condicionibus praesidium quoque praebere potest.

source: Similar to Naboredisley’s Abomination corpse?
target: Simile cadavro Abominationis Naboredisley?

source: The Overseer’s Under the Table transaction couldn’t breach Mr. Fool’s seal, so it had no effect on Termiboros?
target: Transactio “sub mensa” Overseoris non potuit sigillum Domini Stulti frangere, itaque in Termiboro nullum effectum habuit?

source: Lumian nodded in understanding and said to Jenna, “We need to inform Madam Judgment of our suspicions.
target: Lumian intellegens caput inclinavit et ad Jennam dixerat: «Nobis oportet Dominam Iudicium de nostris suspicionibus certiorem facere.»

source: If an Under the Table transaction is indeed at play, she’ll undoubtedly break free of its influence and offer new guidance once alerted.
target: Si revera transactio “sub mensa” agitur, illa certe eius influentiam franget et, monita, nova praecepta offeret.

source: If she’s unaffected, the messenger will just have to put in a bit of extra effort.
target: Si illa non afficitur, nuntius solum modicum conatus addere oportet.

source: “Got it.” Jenna grasped Lumian’s point.
target: «Intelligo,» Jenna sensum Lumiani comprehendi curavit.

source: “Even though we suspect an Under the Table transaction, we can’t act recklessly right now.
target: «Quamquam suspicimur transactionem “sub mensa”, nunc temere agere non possumus.

source: We still require fresh directives from the Major Arcana cardholders.”
target: Nihilominus adhuc nova praecepta a tenentibus cartarum Major Arcana exspectamus.»

source: As Franca waited for Madam Judgment’s reply, she let out a sigh.
target: Dum Franca responsum Dominae Iudicium exspectabat, suspirum edidit.

source: “Is something wrong?” Jenna inquired, her worry apparent.
target: «Numquid aliquid male est?» Jenna inquit, sollicita eius manifeste apparens.

source: Franca responded with a mix of sorrow and outrage, “This Under the Table transaction was exceptionally lavish.
target: Franca, misce luctum et indignationem, respondit: «Haec transactio “sub mensa” eximie luxuriosa fuit.

source: It impacted no fewer than two demigods.
target: Non minus quam duos semideos percussit.

source: The Overseer of the School of Truth must have paid a steep price and offered up a considerable number of precious items.”
target: Overseer Scholae Veritatis certe pretio ingenti solvisset atque multas res pretiosas offerre debuisset.

source: Sure, that’s all true, but what’s it got to do with you?
target: Certe, haec omnia vera sunt, sed quid ad te pertinet?

source: Why are you so worked up about it?
target: Cur de ea tam vehementer commota es?

source: Jenna blinked, struggling to grasp Franca’s train of thought.
target: Jenna palpebravit, conata Francae cogitationem comprehendere.

source: Franca elaborated, “Once Madam Judgment apprehends or eliminates him with our assistance, there won’t be much left in terms of spoils of war for us to divvy up.
target: Franca enarravit: «Quondam Domina Iudicium, cum auxilio nostro eum caperet aut exstirparet, parum reliquum erit ex praediis belli ad dividendum nobis.

source: We might end up with another penniless target like Jebus!”
target: Fortasse alterum sine pecunia destinatum, sicut Jebus, habebimus!

source: Lumian, Jenna, and Anthony were momentarily at a loss for words.
target: Lumian, Jenna, et Anthony per momentum verbis destituti erant.

source: You’re already worrying about hypothetical future spoils?
target: Iam de praediis belli futuris hypotheticis sollicita es?

source: Lumian shifted the topic and turned to Franca and Jenna.
target: Lumian sermonem mutavit et ad Francam atque Jennam se vertit.

source: “When I posed those final two questions to Jebus, why did you two lean in closer to me? Did you sense that something was about to go awry?”
target: «Cum ultimas duas quaestiones Jebum posuissem, cur vos duo propius ad me inclinastis? Sensistisne aliquid imminere male?»

source: “Naturally, it was a Demoness’s intuitive premonition,” Franca declared smugly.
target: «Certe, erat intuitiva praemonitio Demonissae,» Franca superbius dixerat.

source: While I couldn’t pinpoint what exactly would happen, being nearer to you provided me with more options for dealing with potential threats.
target: Quamquam quid exacte eveniret definire non potui, propius ad vos esse mihi plures optiones ad pericula tractanda praebebat.

source: Jenna gave a subtle nod, indicating that she felt the same way.
target: Jenna subdole caput inclinavit, indicans se idem sentire.

source: Lumian faced Anthony. “What about you?”
target: Lumian Antonium respexit. «Et tu quid?»

source: Anthony answered honestly, “I suspected that the last two questions would snap Jebus out of his hypnotic state.
target: Anthony honestē respondit: «Suspicabar ultimas duas quaestiones Jebum e statu suo hypnotico evellere.

source: Franca and Jenna’s reactions indirectly validated my concerns.
target: Responsiones Francae et Jennæ indirecte meas curas confirmaverunt.»

source: “Given that, it seemed prudent to take cover behind you two.”
target: «Quamobrem, videbatur prudentissimum esse, ut me sub vobis duos texerem.»

source: “So you’re using us as human shields?” Franca remarked with a wry smile.
target: «Ita nos ut scuta humana uteris?» Franca cum risu aspero inquit.

source: Anthony nodded earnestly. “You two have Mirror Substitution at your disposal.”
target: Anthony sincē caput inclinavit. «Vobis duobus substitutio speculi ad usum praesto est.»

source: “Fair point,” Franca conceded.
target: «Recte,» Franca concedit.

source: After a short while, Madam Judgment’s messenger delivered a response.
target: Post parvum tempus, nuntius Dominae Iudicium responsum attulit.

source: The message was succinct: “Proceed with your course of action.”
target: Nuntius concisus erat: «Procedite in cursum vestrum agendi.»

source: Does this imply that the Major Arcana cardholders will monitor the situation?
target: Num hoc significat tenentes cartarum Major Arcana rem observaturos esse?

source: Have they consulted with Ma’am Hermit?
target: Num consulerunt cum Domina Eremita?

source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully and grinned at Franca and the others.
target: Lumian, cogitans, caput inclinavit et ad Francam atque ceteros subridens respexit.

source: “Let’s stick to our initial plan.”
target: «Maneamus ad consilium nostrum initium.»

source: “The initial plan?” Franca started, taken aback.
target: «Consilium initium?» Franca incepit, stupefacta.

source: “Precisely,” Lumian confirmed, still smiling.
target: «Prorsus,» Lumian confirmavit, adhuc subridente.

source: “Over the next several hours, potentially even a full day, the Overseer and the other Mirror People certainly won’t be guarding Moran Avigny from behind the full‐length mirror in his study.
target: «Per proximas horas, fortasse etiam totam diem, Overseor et ceteri Homines Specularum certe Moran Avigny non custodiabunt ab speculo pleno in studio suo.»

source: That should be a necessary condition for the Under the Table transaction to succeed.
target: Id debet esse conditionis necessariae ad transactionem “sub mensa” perficiendam.

source: The Demoness of Black has already inspected those locations, and the Overseer is unaware of when she might do so again.
target: Demonissa Nigra iam illos locos inspicuit, et Overseor nescit quando illa iterum id facere possit.

source: He needs to allow sufficient time.
target: Ei sufficiens tempus concedendus est.

source: “Put another way, if we conceal ourselves within that mirror, we’ll be safe from disruption and harm.”
target: «Alio modo dictum, si nos intra illum speculum celamus, a perturbatione et laesione salvi erimus.»

source: Jenna’s brow furrowed slightly.
target: Frons Jennæ leviter corrugata est.

source: “But doesn’t the heart of the issue lie in the fact that Moran Avigny won’t be entering the full‐length mirror anytime soon?
target: «Num non in ipsa re cordis consistit quod Moran Avigny cito in speculum plenum non intrabit?

source: How can we ambush him…”
target: Quomodo eum insidiari possumus…»

source: Jenna abruptly trailed off, as if a thought had just occurred to her.
target: Jenna subito cessavit loqui, quasi mox cogitatio illi advenisset.

source: Lumian’s grin widened. “The Overseer may resort to an Under the Table transaction, but so can we!”
target: Risus Lumiani latius expansus est. «Overseer ad transactionem “sub mensa” recursus esse potest, sed et nos id efficere possumus!»

source: “Indeed, the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction!” Franca immediately grasped Lumian’s implication.
target: «Certe, transactio “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis!» Franca statim sensum Lumiani captavit.

source: Lumian planned to harness the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction to plant the idea in Moran Avigny’s mind to re‐enter the full‐length mirror!
target: Lumian consilium ceperat ut transactionem “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis adhiberet, ut ideam in mente Moran Avigny insideret, de reintroitu in speculum plenum instauranda.

source: As for how an Under the Table transaction would enable such an arrangement to work, that wasn’t their concern.
target: Quoad quomodo transactio “sub mensa” talem ordinationem efficere posset, id non eorum cura erat.

source: Even the Overseer probably didn’t know the inner workings of the Under the Table transaction.
target: Etiam Overseor probabiliter interna transactionis “sub mensa” non novit.

source: Under the Table dealings were, in a sense, a black box!
target: Negotia “sub mensa”, quatenus quidem, erant quasi arca nigra!

source: With Magic Mirror Divination verifying the level of risk, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony ventured into the enigmatic and shadowy realm via the mirror world entrance affixed to the jutting rock.
target: Magica Speculi Divinatio periculum gradu probans, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony in regnum arcānum et umbraticum per ingressum mundi specularis in saxo protuberante adfixum se contulerunt.

source: Surveying the spiderweb-like void passageways stretching to unknown destinations, Lumian activated the Mirror Mark contract imprinted on him.
target: Percontans vias vacuas retis araneae similes, quae ad ignotas destinationes extendebantur, Lumian contractum Sigilli Speculi in se impressum activavit.

source: He then addressed Franca and the others, “I can detect the full‐length mirror and determine its precise whereabouts.”
target: Deinde Francae et ceteris dedit verba: «Speculum plenum detegere atque eius locum exacte determinare possum.»

source: “In that case, let’s make our way there immediately.”
target: «Ergo, statim, pergemus ad illuc.»

source: Franca pulled up her Assassin suit’s hood once more and latched onto Lumian’s arm.
target: Franca iterum cucullam vestis assassinorum sustulit et ad brachium Lumiani se alligavit.

source: She had already donned the Mirror Cufflink, but why squander one of its uses when other means were available?
target: Iamdudum fibulam specularis induta erat, sed cur unum ex eius usibus perdere, cum alia media praesto essent?

source: As soon as Jenna and Anthony grabbed hold of him again, Lumian triggered the Spirit World Traversal mark and teleported through one of the dark, vacant passageways to a deep, black aqueous light.
target: Statim ut Jenna et Anthony eum iterum prehendere coeptis sunt, Lumian signum Transitus Spiritus Mundi activavit et per unum ex viis obscuris et vacuis in lucem aquaticam profundam nigram se teleportavit.

source: The aqueous light signified a mirror with a corresponding hazy zone linked to myriad illusory tunnels akin to spiderwebs.
target: Lux aquosa speculum significabat, cuius regio nebulosa correspondebat ad innumerabiles tunellos fallacibus, similes retibus araneis.

source: Lumian peered into the dark aqueous light and observed the scene through the glass mirror. It was undoubtedly Moran Avigny’s study.
target: Lumian in lucem aquaticam obscuram intuebatur et scaenam per speculum vitri observavit. Indubitate, erat studium Moran Avigny.

source: Franca likewise recognized the target’s position and breathed a sigh of relief.
target: Franca quoque locum destinatæ agnovit et suspirum levationis exhalavit.

source: “I’ll handle the Under the Table transaction.”
target: «Ego transactionem “sub mensa” curabo.»

source: “Allow me.” Lumian smiled. “Given what transpired earlier, I might encounter Demons even without the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction. In that case, I might as well use it freely.”
target: «Permitte mihi,» Lumian subridens inquit. «Quod ante evenit, fortasse daemonibus occurram etiam sine transactione “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis; in illo casu, libere id adhibere possum.»

source: He was alluding to the events surrounding Naboredisley.
target: Ad res circa Naboredisley versatos alludebat.

source: “Very well.” Franca yielded to Lumian’s reasoning. “Then I’ll cover the cost!”
target: «Valde bene.» Franca ratione Lumiani cessit. «Ergo sumptus solvam!»

source: She produced 5,000 verl d’or worth of gold from her Traveler’s Bag.
target: Ex sacco viatoris, aurum prodidit cum valore 5,000 verl d’or.

source: Lumian accepted without protest and said to Jenna and the others, “The transaction I aim to complete is to instill in Moran Avigny the notion of entering the full‐length mirror in his study. Then, I’ll employ Compelling Fate to transform that notion into reality.”
target: Lumian sine dissentire accepit et ad Jennam atque ceteros dixerat: «Transactio quam perficere opto est, ut in mente Moran Avigny notionem inseram ut in speculum plenum in studio suo ingrediatur; deinde Fatum Coactum adhibebo, ut illam notionem in rem veram transformem.»

source: “This is far simpler than directly compelling Moran Avigny to enter the mirror. The price will undoubtedly be lower.”
target: «Hoc longe simplicius est quam directe cogere Moran Avigny ut speculum intraret; pretium indubitanter minorem erit.»

source: “Understood.” Jenna retrieved the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction from her backpack.
target: «Intelligo.» Jenna ex sacculo suo extraxit transactionem “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis.

source: The small, dark wooden box still had eight uses remaining.
target: Parva, atra arca lignea adhuc octo usus reliquos habebat.

source: Lumian grasped Franca’s pouch of gold coins in his right hand and reached through the membrane-like “curtain.”
target: Lumian marsupium aureorum nummorum Francae in manu dextra apprehendit et per velum simile membranae tendit.

source: He then felt five damp, wrinkled fingers. They swiftly closed around the pouch containing the gold coins.
target: Deinde quinque digiti humidi et rugosi sensit; celeriter circum marsupium, quod nummos aureos continebat, complectebantur.

source: Lumian’s expression remained neutral as he articulated his request in Hermes.
target: Vultus Lumiani manebat aequus, dum petitionem suam in lingua “Hermes” enarrabat.

source: After a brief pause, the wrinkled, moist palm returned the pouch of gold coins.
target: Post breve intervallum, palma rugosa et humida marsupium aureorum nummorum reddidit.

source: Wh— Lumian glanced up and apprised Franca and the others of the development.
target: Quid— Lumian sursum aspexit et Francam atque ceteros de progressu certiorem fecit.

source: Franca promptly understood. “It’s demanding more money!”
target: Franca statim intellexit. «Plus pecuniae postulat!»

source: Her heart sank as she produced additional banknotes and gold, but the slightly cold, wrinkled palm kept rejecting the payment.
target: Cor eius deiectum est, dum alias chartas monetarias et aurum prodidit, sed palma modice frigida et rugosa iterum pretium reiecit.

source: Lumian contributed tens of thousands of verl d’or, yet the transaction still wouldn’t go through.
target: Lumian decies milia verl d’or attulit, tamen transactio adhuc non procedebat.

source: “Could it be that Under the Table doesn’t desire money or gold?” Jenna recalled Jebus’s insights regarding the Broker pathway.
target: «Num fieri potest ut “sub mensa” non desideret pecuniam aut aurum?» Jenna recordata est intuitionem Jebus de semita Broker.

source: “Perhaps it requires a mystical item?” Lumian pondered, considering what he could offer.
target: «Fortasse rem mysticam requiritur?» Lumian meditatus est, quid offerre posset.

source: Franca deliberated for a moment before suggesting, “What about the Blood Gold ring? It has considerable drawbacks, and we’ve hardly used it.”
target: Franca paulisper deliberavit, deinde suadens: «Quid de anulo Aurosanguineo? Habet incommoditates considerabiles, atque vix id usi sumus.»

source: The Blood Gold ring had come from Mad Lady and corresponded to some of the capabilities of a Sequence 6 Rose Bishop of the Secrets Suppliant pathway.
target: Anulus Aurosanguineus ex “Mad Lady” ortus erat et cum quibusdam facultatibus “Sequence 6 Rose Bishop” itineris Secretorum Supplicantium conveniebat.

source: The four of them conferred for a while before deciding to attempt the transaction with the Blood Gold ring.
target: Quattuor aliquantulum consultaverunt antequam decreverunt transactionem cum anulo Aurosanguineo tentare.

source: The moment the Blood Gold ring touched Under the Table, the five fingers of the palm clenched firmly and withdrew, taking the ring with them.
target: Mox, cum anulus Aurosanguineus “sub mensa” contigisset, quinque digiti palmae firmiter contracti sunt et recedentes anulum secum allotaverunt.

source: This indicated that the deal had been finalized.
target: Hoc indicabat pactum finaliter conclusum esse.

source: Phew… Lumian exhaled in relief and remarked, “I’m curious to see how the Under the Table transaction will unfold…”
target: Fuf… Lumian leviter suspiravit et inquit: «Curiosus sum videre quomodo transactio “sub mensa” evolvetur…»

source: Franca pressed a hand to her chest and prayed to Mr. Fool, “Please don’t let us run into any swindlers. Praise The Fool!”
target: Franca manum ad pectus premens ad Dominum Stultum oravit: «Quaeso, ne in fallacibus incidamus. Laudate Stultum!»
